head: faea5a613dbb8d72e720cf5afc94b57571ce1a54
claim: A key lane lists every model the vendor lists, even when the app's config already registers a shorter list

steps.start: Worktree built with npm run build; no app config registering a model list; a fresh throwaway HOME and a fresh engine directory; no key saved yet.
steps: Read the key from the sanctioned MiniMax key file path passed as argv, printing only 'key read ok'.
Created an OpenClawKit with a fresh state directory and started it (the pinned engine starts).
Saved the MiniMax key on member m1 with the minimax-global-api choice (addKey returned status ok).
Listed m1's models for minimax-global-api (models()) and printed each row's id, available and offline fields.
Added the unlisted id minimax/not-yet-listed-model with addKey (returned status ok).
Added minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash with addKey (returned status ok).
Ran one reply on minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash with auth apiKey and the message 'Reply with one word.' (returned ok with text 'Ready').
Listed m1's models again after the run and printed each row's id, available and offline fields.
Stopped the kit and exited; ran the secret check on the captured text.
steps.result: The captured text lists nine MiniMax models for the key lane (MiniMax-M2 through MiniMax-M3.1-Flash, each available), including minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash and minimax/MiniMax-M3; the unlisted-id and Flash adds return status ok; the run on minimax/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash returns ok with the text 'Ready'; the list after the run is the same nine models.
